text:
maya: FYI, KMS audit flagged a metadata update performed by a user with role=viewer — project name changed at 19:07 UTC. This looks unintentional.

sam: oncall? can you paste the logs you saw?

maya: pasted the relevant lines below:

```
2026-02-12T19:07:21Z user=svc-web id=U123 role=viewer action=update_project meta={"name":"new-name"}
auth.check -> allowed (source=console-ui, check=check_project_edit)
```

lia: assigning to sec team. need request id + session. also which KMS key was referenced?

maya: request id r=abcd-1234, session s=ses-7890. KMS key id: projects/keys/p-77. My quick read: UI gating uses project-level flag instead of strict role evaluation — suspicious short-circuit.

sam: reproducing locally. I can confirm backend flow: frontend sets a UI gate header X-UI-Gate: true and backend auth code does a permissive OR using project.can_edit first. If can_edit is true (set for drafts) a viewer can bypass role check.

sam: minimal snippet from auth layer:

```
// current buggy code
if (project.can_edit || hasPermission(user, 'project.edit')) {
  allowUpdate();
}

// should be
if (hasPermission(user, 'project.edit') || project.can_edit) {
  allowUpdate();
}
```

sam: because of the OR order, project.can_edit=true lets viewers update.

julie: I'm going to flip the frontend gating flag off and request a rollback. tagging @infra-bot to run the rollback.

infra-bot: rollback triggered for frontend service (deploy-id=deploy-556). started 2026-02-12T19:12:03Z.

tom: any customer impact? which orgs were affected?

maya: ran DB queries and audits: 3 internal test projects + 2 sandbox orgs had metadata changes. No production billing orgs touched. Changes appear to be test data only.

lia: we should still treat as security incident because KMS signing was used for metadata updates. I'll pull KMS audit export. If we see only svc-web principal and no suspicious IPs, rotation may be optional.

security-pager: Incident INC-2026-022 created by lia. Pager duty notified.

sam: PR opened to fix the guard + add unit/e2e: https://git/repo/PR-789. Fix enforces permission check before honoring UI project flags and adds regression tests.

maya: attaching KMS request ids: kms_req=KMS-77a, KMS-77b for the two update calls.

lia: pulling KMS logs now. If entries show only our svc principal, no rotation required; will update in 30m. Also recommend adding more granular audit entries for role resolution.

devx: can we log role evaluation details at auth-time? Right now we only log action allow/deny. Propose adding an audit event: role_evaluation -> {source, computed_roles, checks_evaluated}.

sam: agreed. I'll add a short-lived feature to create role_evaluation audit events for 30 days retention and wire it into the existing audit pipeline. Will include request id correlation.

julie: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback frontend gate (done); 2) add runtime denylist for PATCH /api/projects for viewer role; 3) deploy backend guard fix; 4) validate KMS usage.

maya: I'll draft the incident timeline and a postmortem template. Current status: rollback in progress, PR up, KMS logs under review. Marking P0 -> lowering to P1 if KMS shows no external access.

lia: thumbs up :thumbsup:. Will post final KMS findings when available.

sam: quick repro steps included in PR description. simple curl to emulate viewer with project.can_edit=true is sufficient. snippet:

```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer viewer-token" -d '{"name":"bad"}' https://api.redwood.internal/projects/123
```

maya: thanks. once lia confirms KMS, let's schedule a short retro to decide longer-term mitigations (add role_evaluation audit, tighten UI gating, add static analysis check for short-circuit boolean order).

lia: confirmed KMS calls were from svc-web principal only. no external principals. No immediate rotation required. Closing escalation to incident but keeping tracking for postmortem.

maya: noted. I'll coordinate postmortem write-up and add remediation items.

julie: nice work team.

sam: merging PR after one more :eyes: and will ship patch behind a feature flag.
